children: Based on the charts, the long-term outlook is bullish for Zensar Technologies (₹568). The stock has formed a strong base above ₹400. There is double-bottom pattern formation visible on the chart. This is a bullish reversal pattern. Resistance is around ₹640 which can be tested in the short term. Chart analysis indicates there are good chances for the stock to breach ₹640.

Such a break can trigger a fresh rally towards ₹1,000-₹1,100 over the next four to six quarters. Long-term investors can consider Zensar Technologies which is now trading at ₹568. Further, can also consider accumulating on dips at ₹530. Keep the stop-loss at ₹360 initially. Trail the stop-loss up to ₹620 as soon as the share goes up to ₹730. Revise the stop-loss higher to ₹760 and ₹920 when the price touches ₹880 and ₹990 respectively. Exit the stock at ₹1,050. The bullish view will go wrong if the share price declines below ₹380, a crucial support.

title: Muhurat Stock spotlight: Zensar Technologies
